content: Hi, I would like to order two chicken biryani for delivery, please.
Got it, two chicken biryani. Would you like to add any raita or anything else?
No, just the biryani, please. What is the total?
That will be eighteen hundred for the biryani plus one fifty for delivery, so nineteen fifty total, and it will take about forty-five minutes.
That is fine. My address is 42-B, Block 6, PECHS.
